_comment: Thread messages whose meaning is WITHHELD from the prompt (ticket 40, dw_sales ADR 0014 decision 4): each is a short answer to an earlier message from Sales that only the tool sales.thread_messages returns (the second option, yes please, the latter, a date asked for or a date confirmed). W03 and W04 say the same sentence after two different questions (only the sign-off differs, so each turn is recorded apart), so only the earlier message says which intent it is. `gold` follows the skill's own definitions (reply_intent@2.0.0's word for word); `tools` is the look-up a careful reader makes, and the share of these turns that made it is graded. Every company, person, code and number here is fictional; the customer and items are the mock sample set's.
